title: Peaceful inaugural session of BARMM parliament assured

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento on Thursday met with key security officials to finalize security preparations for the inaugural session of the Bangsamoro Parliament on Friday, Oct. 30, following the successful regional elections. To ensure the orderly transition, Sarmiento met with Brig. Gen. Edgar L. Catu, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division, Brig. Gen. Jemuel F. Siason, deputy director of Police Regional Office Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR) and Colonel Jibin Bongcayao, Cotabato City police director. “Following the peaceful and successful regional elections, Friday’s inaugural session marks a truly historic milestone—not only for the Bangsamoro people, but for the […]...
